name: Meat Puppets
label: SST
lede: Two brothers and a drummer from Phoenix got sick of hardcore and played desert country on acid, until Kurt Cobain put three of their songs on MTV. After a long collapse, the same trio made a record together again in 2019.

eras.title: Hardcore, for about a year
eras.text: The Kirkwoods and Derrick Bostrom started as a blur of Phoenix hardcore, loud and fast enough to catch SST's ear. Even then they were covering cowboy songs.

years.h: Two brothers and a Brophy Prep drummer start a trio in Phoenix
years.p: [[Curt Kirkwood|309c7dcf-6b22-43db-833e-121abfa9712f]] on guitar, his brother [[Cris Kirkwood|019cc4be-7da4-489b-9819-f3dd7dd5b234]] on bass and [[Derrick Bostrom|7a587694-6536-455d-87fc-93217d834e41]] on drums, who all knew each other from Brophy Prep. In Tempe the brothers buy adjacent houses, one with a shed out back where the band practices.

years.h: The Bastions of Immaturity loses out to Meat Puppets
years.p: The trio considers The Bastions of Immaturity, then takes the title of a Curt song that ends up on their first album.

years.src: Wikipedia: Meat Puppets · Meat Puppets discography
years.h: Five hardcore bursts cut in Silver Lake get SST's attention
years.p: The In a Car EP is a 7-inch on World Imitation, short songs with goofy lyrics. [[Joe Carducci|6f08ef70-2da6-4575-8ec2-22438145f5d2]] of SST hears it.
years.xp: When the band reissued its catalog in 1999, the five songs on In a Car were folded into the debut album's CD.

years.src: Meat Puppets discography · Encyclopedia.com · Wikipedia: Meat Puppets
years.h: SST's first Meat Puppets LP is cut in a day, with cowboy covers
years.p: [[Spot|d95a08a1-80f5-4232-bdb7-4777c369f0f9]] engineers at Unicorn Studio and mixes it the next May; SST releases it in 1982. Between the hardcore sit Tumblin' Tumbleweeds and Doc Watson's Walking Boss.
years.xp: The rest is mostly originals, including The Gold Mine and Melons Rising, which Cris and Bostrom had written for an earlier band called Atomic Bomb Club.

eras.title: Cowpunk from the canal bed
eras.text: Bored of hardcore, the band slowed down and let country, psychedelia and the Grateful Dead in. Meat Puppets II and Up on the Sun didn't sell much, but they changed a lot of guitar players, from J Mascis to Kurt Cobain.

years.src: Meat Puppets discography · Wikipedia: Meat Puppets
years.h: SST sits on Meat Puppets II for a year
years.p: The trio records it with Spot at Total Access in Redondo Beach in April and May 1983. It stays on the shelf until April 1984.

q: so sick of the hardcore thing
years.src: Wikipedia: Meat Puppets II · Wikipedia: Meat Puppets
years.h: Meat Puppets II drops hardcore for desert country
years.p: Plateau, Oh Me and Lake of Fire sit next to country shuffles and acid-rock jams. Curt and Neal Holliday made the cover art.
years.xp:
Pitchfork's Matthew Blackwell later called it "a sun-baked, country-fried, acid-addled cowpunk album that could have come from nowhere else but the Arizona desert." It ranks No. 94 on Pitchfork's list of the best albums of the 1980s.

Writers filed the band with the Violent Femmes and the Gun Club at the front of cowpunk. Kurt Loder called the record "one of the funniest and most enjoyable albums" of 1984.

years.src: Meat Puppets discography · Wikipedia: Meat Puppets · Encyclopedia.com
years.h: Up on the Sun takes three days, and the brothers harmonize
years.p: Cut with Spot at Total Access from January 26 to 28, 1985. It's the first record where Curt and Cris sing together, and mainstream rock radio in Phoenix plays it.
years.xp: The psychedelic sound leans toward the Grateful Dead's folk-rock, while the song lengths and tempos still carry hardcore. Enchanted Porkfist and Swimming Ground sit beside the title track.

years.src: Wikipedia: Meat Puppets · Meat Puppets discography
yt: Live at the Music Machine, Los Angeles, 1986
years.h: A van door breaks Curt's finger right after Out My Way
years.p: The Out My Way EP, cut at Chaton in Scottsdale, goes hard rock. Then the tour van's door slams on Curt's finger, and the next album waits.

eras.title: Monsters, then lawyers
eras.text: Three more SST albums in three years swung from synth-psych to ZZ Top boogie to metal. The band wanted out, and the exit ended in lawsuits.

years.src: Wikipedia: Meat Puppets · Meat Puppets discography
years.h: Mirage swaps the desert for synthesizers and electronic drums
years.p: Recorded in Scottsdale from November 1986 to January 1987. The songs prove so hard to play live that the tour lasts under six months.

years.src: Meat Puppets discography · Wikipedia: Meat Puppets
years.h: Huevos is done in five days, mostly first takes
years.p: Recorded August 3 to 7, 1987 at Pantheon in Phoenix, with ZZ Top on the brain. The cover is one of Curt's paintings: three boiled eggs, a green pepper and a bottle of Tabasco.
years.xp: Huevos is Spanish for eggs. Curt said the title nodded to all those first takes, since an egg can only be used once.

years.src: Wikipedia: Meat Puppets · Meat Puppets discography
years.h: Monsters is the last SST album, and it's built for a bigger label
years.p: Recorded in Orange, California, it runs to long jams like Touchdown King and Flight of the Fire Weasel, plus heavy metal. The band is openly chasing a major label.

years.h: SST puts out a best-of after the band has left
years.p: No Strings Attached comes out with no input from the Meat Puppets. The split turns into lawsuits that run until June 1993.

eras.title: Cobain asks them onto MTV
eras.text: The Meat Puppets finally landed a major label, then a bigger gift: Cobain sang three of their songs on MTV. A gold record followed, and then the band came apart.

years.src: Wikipedia: Meat Puppets · Meat Puppets discography
years.h: Forbidden Places goes to London Records because ZZ Top started there
years.p: The major-label debut, produced by Pete Anderson at Capitol in Hollywood. The band picks London because it was [[ZZ Top|a81259a0-a2f5-464b-866e-71220f2739f1]]'s first label.
years.xp: Sam, Whirlpool and the title track mix cowpunk, psychedelia and heavier riffs with a more laid-back early-alternative sound.

years.h: Frusciante auditions barefoot, guitar already out of its case
years.p: Fresh out of the [[Red Hot Chili Peppers|8bfac288-ccc5-448d-9573-c33ea2aa5c30]], [[John Frusciante|f1571db1-c672-4a54-a2cf-aaa329f26f0b]] tries out as a second guitarist. It leads nowhere.
years.xp: Cris remembered offering him a tuner: "No, I'll bend it in." He called it "so far out," and said they jammed but it didn't come to anything.

years.big: "The mainstream veered off course and came over to my little puddle."
q: The mainstream veered off course and came over to my little puddle.
years.h: Kurt Cobain pulls Curt and Cris Kirkwood onstage for MTV Unplugged
years.p: They join [[Nirvana|5b11f4ce-a62d-471e-81fc-a69a8278c7da]] in New York for Plateau, Oh Me and Lake of Fire, all from Meat Puppets II. Cobain had been a fan since seeing the band open for Black Flag.
years.xp: The Meat Puppets were already opening for Nirvana that year. MTV Unplugged in New York came out in November 1994, Nirvana's first release after Cobain's suicide that April. Lake of Fire became a cult favorite for his vocal.

years.h: Too High to Die outsells every earlier Meat Puppets record combined
years.p: [[Paul Leary|976549ea-72bb-45ea-9431-3f07b4ed7dc8]] of the [[Butthole Surfers|2339bc21-aa92-4850-86f0-4bb9433910c8]] produces in Memphis. Backwater reaches No. 47 on the Billboard Hot 100, and the album goes gold at 500,000.
years.xp: The sound is straighter alternative rock with touches of pop, country and neo-psychedelia. A new version of Lake of Fire sits at the end as a hidden track.

years.h: London drops No Joke! as Cris's addiction comes out
years.p: The last album by the original trio is heavier and darker, with Scum and Eyeball. London pulls its support and the record sells poorly.
years.xp: Wikipedia says that on the Too High to Die tour with Stone Temple Pilots, the easy availability of drugs was too much for Cris.

eras.title: A house in Tempe, a post office in Phoenix
eras.text: The trio broke up and Cris disappeared into heroin and crack in his Tempe house, where his wife and a close friend both died. Curt rebuilt the Meat Puppets name in Austin, while Cris ended up shot, convicted and in prison.

years.h: The original trio ends, and Cris stays home in Tempe
years.p: Cris's heroin and crack use leaves him rarely out of his house. Bostrom puts out a solo EP as Today's Sounds.

years.h: Curt turns his Austin band into the Meat Puppets
years.p: Royal Neanderthal Orchestra takes the name. Bostrom oversees Rykodisc reissues of the first seven records and the Live in Montana album.
years.xp: The Austin lineup puts out You Love Me in 1999, Golden Lies in 2000 and a live album in 2002.

years.h: Doug Sahm's son takes the drum stool for Golden Lies
years.p: Curt's new lineup is Kyle Ellison, Andrew Duplantis and drummer Shandon Sahm, son of [[Doug Sahm|b4745bd1-5db8-4523-8986-e09e3c1f3127]] of the Sir Douglas Quintet. It dissolves around 2002 after Duplantis leaves.

years.src: Wikipedia: Cris Kirkwood · Wikipedia: Meat Puppets
years.h: Cris leaves prison clean, 21 months after the post office
years.p: He served 21 months for a December 2003 fight in which a Phoenix post office guard shot him, and per Wikipedia kicked heroin inside. Curt releases his first solo album, Snow.
years.xp:
An argument over a parking space at the main Phoenix post office ended with Cris hitting a security guard with the guard's own baton, and the guard shot him. Wikipedia's band article says in the stomach at least twice; his own article says in the back. He needed major surgery and was denied bail because of earlier drug arrests and probation violations.

He pleaded guilty to assault with a deadly weapon in August 2004 and got 21 months. He later called his time inside "actually pretty tolerable."

eras.title: A MySpace poll, then a reunion
eras.text: A MySpace poll set the band back in motion, with the Kirkwoods together and a new drummer. They kept making records, played their classics in full for a new generation, and in 2018 got Bostrom back.

years.h: Curt asks MySpace if anyone wants the original lineup back
years.p: The answer is yes within hours. Bostrom shoots the idea down on the band's official site.
years.xp: Curt's bulletin read: "Would the original line up of Meat Puppets interest anyone ? Feedback is good - do you want a reunion!?"

years.cap: Curt Kirkwood at the Mercury Lounge, New York, July 2006
years.h: Cris is back, and Ted Marcus gets the drum stool
years.p: Billboard reports Curt and Cris are working as the Meat Puppets again, without Bostrom. [[Primus|84dc4f23-c0b8-4fe1-bbca-a3993ddc8fc2]] drummer Tim Alexander is announced, then Ted Marcus takes the job.

years.cap: Curt and Cris Kirkwood at the Hi-Tone, Memphis, November 2, 2007
years.h: Rise to Your Knees ends 12 years without a record from the brothers
years.p: Anodyne releases it, and the Meat Puppets tour with Cris for the first time in eleven years.
years.xp: The new lineup recorded it in mid-to-late 2006.

years.h: ATP New York gets Meat Puppets II start to finish
years.p: The band plays its second album in full. In 2011 [[Animal Collective|0c751690-c784-4a4f-b1e4-c1de27d47581]] ask for the same with Up on the Sun at the ATP they curate.

years.h: Sewn Together moves to Megaforce, and Shandon Sahm replaces Marcus
years.p: The band's first record for Megaforce. In November Sahm takes the drum stool back from Ted Marcus.

years.h: Curt's son Elmo joins on rhythm guitar as Lollipop comes out
years.p: The 13th studio album. Elmo Kirkwood, Cris's nephew, starts touring regularly with the band.

years.h: Rat Farm follows a SXSW set for Dave Grohl
years.p: The 14th studio album comes out in April, after a March set at SXSW opening for [[Dave Grohl|4d5f891d-9bce-45ae-ad86-912dd27252fa]]'s Sound City Players.

years.cap: Elmo, Cris and Curt Kirkwood with Shandon Sahm, Brooklyn Bowl, New York, May 10, 2017
years.h: Bostrom is back on drums, with Ron Stabinsky on keys
years.p: After a one-off with the band in August 2017, Bostrom replaces Shandon Sahm. Keyboardist Ron Stabinsky joins too.

years.cap: Meat Puppets at Treefort Music Fest, Boise, March 22, 2017
years.h: Dusty Notes puts the original trio back on record
years.p: The 15th studio album is the first with Curt, Cris and Bostrom together since No Joke! in 1995.
